'''Daegin Strell''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] charity worker in [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. He was well regarded as a leader, enough so that the [[Strell House]] was named after him. He was popular enough that even by [[3643 BBY]], nearly ten years after his death, his name still meant something to the populace.<ref name="rot" />
